title: Pitita wins España Season 3
summary: In the Grand Finale (ES-S03-E11), Pitita and Vania Vainilla lip-synced to Rocío Jurado's "Punto de partida". Pitita was crowned Spain's next Drag Superstar.

title: The Macarena returns for Season 3
summary: The Macarena, first eliminated on España Season 1, returned as a surprise 13th contestant on Season 3 and placed 10th after elimination in ES-S03-E05.

title: Kelly Roller returns via Second Chance
summary: After elimination in ES-S03-E04, Kelly Roller returned in ES-S03-E07's Second Chance challenge and ultimately finished as a finalist (tied 3rd/4th).
